pairs.english: Downstairs someone slapped hot flatbreads onto a board again and again; across the street, it sounded surprisingly like the hooks knocking at the receiving platform. He stood listening awhile before remembering he still had not asked who drew that crooked fish.

楼下有人将热饼拍在木板上，一下又一下，隔着街，竟与接台那边敲钩的声音差不多。
他站着听了一会儿，才想起自己还没问那条歪鱼是谁画的。
